## Context

The review bot's reported token totals are incomplete: the Pass-1 finder batch does not surface its
usage on the batch step output, so the finalize step has nothing to fold in and the CloudWatch
totals under-report every code review by the whole Pass-1 finder leg.

**This ticket is now scoped to the CODE-REVIEW half only.** The plan-review half of the original
scope already landed under ticket `d52a`: `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py:684` sets
`coverage["usage"] = aggregate_usage(call_records)`, and
`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/production_batch_runner.py:199` surfaces it as
`"_usage": coverage.get("usage") or aggregate_usage([])`. Re-scoped 2026-08-09 after a status
audit found that half delivered and this half untouched; do not re-do the plan-review work.

What remains, verified outstanding on `origin/main`:

- `src/rebar/llm/code_review/batch_runner.py:130` emits `outputs={"findings", "criteria_count",
  "batch_plan"}` — there is no `usage` key anywhere in the file.
- `src/rebar/llm/code_review/finalize.py:139-141` carries a present-tense comment recording the gap
  ("the Pass-1 finder batch does not surface `_usage` on its step output (follow-up)"), which is
  now this ticket and becomes stale the moment it is fixed.
- `src/rebar/llm/code_review/finalize.py:169-172` ALREADY folds `_usage` into the totals when a step
  emits it, so the consuming side needs no change — this is an emit-side fix.

## Plan

Mirror the shape `d52a` established on the plan-review side rather than inventing a second
convention: aggregate the Pass-1 finder call records in the code-review batch runner and emit them
under the same `_usage` step-output key `finalize.py` already reads. Then delete the stale
follow-up comment in `finalize.py`, because a comment describing a closed gap is worse than none.

Keep the change emit-side only. Do not modify `finalize.py`'s folding arithmetic — it is already
correct and covered; touching it would widen the blast radius for no gain.

## Testing

A code-review finalize unit test that asserts the finder-batch usage reaches the folded totals: it
must FAIL before the emit change (the key is absent, so the fold contributes zero) and pass after.
Assert on the folded total rather than on the presence of the key, so the test proves the number is
actually complete rather than that a dict has a key.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `src/rebar/llm/code_review/batch_runner.py` emits Pass-1 finder token usage on its batch step
      output under the same `_usage` key that `finalize.py:169-172` already consumes.
- [x] The aggregation uses the same helper and shape as the plan-review side established by `d52a`,
      so the two paths do not diverge into two conventions.
- [x] The stale gap comment at `src/rebar/llm/code_review/finalize.py:139-141` is removed.
- [x] A held-out unit test asserts the finder-batch usage is included in the finalized code-review
      totals, verified RED before the emit change and GREEN after.
- [x] `finalize.py`'s existing folding arithmetic is unchanged, and the existing code-review
      finalize tests pass unmodified.
